remarks: Welcome to 38 Rowayton Woods Drive, a beautifully renovated residence in the sought-after Rowayton Woods community. The 2021 renovation includes a stylish kitchen, refreshed bathroom, and hardwood floors throughout, while fresh interior paint completed in 2026 makes the home clean, polished, and truly move-in ready. Rowayton Woods offers exceptional amenities, including a swimming pool, tennis court, communal garden area, and a footbridge providing direct access to the Rowayton Train Station for an easy commute. Ideally located close to the charming village of Rowayton, Metro-North, I-95, and New York City, with SONO's shopping, dining, and entertainment just minutes away. A wonderful combination of comfort, community amenities, and an incredibly convenient location.
